ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) Orig/Bene country different from bank country

This scenario generates an alert when the aggregate number and amount of deposits/withdrawal transactions are higher than specific predetermined thresholds. The deposits/withdrawals are made by focal entity from country, which is different from send/ receive bank for wire transaction and issue/deposit bank for monetary instruments.
Org Bene country out of bank country

-- PRIMARY RULE -- ML_OrgBenediffInstnCountry_EN_PR with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt, (select add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Freq_Dt, (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM ='SYSCAL') as Max_Smry_Dt, (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'),-@EN_Smry_Lookback_Period ) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') as Min_Smry_Dt FROM dual ),
Wire_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.ORIG_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.DATA_DUMP_DT, DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Trxn_Am, tr.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, (CASE WHEN tr.PASS_THRU_FL='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AMT, (CASE WHEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) - TRUNC(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM), -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) LRF_AMT, case when tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt, tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, tr.ORIG_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.SEND_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.RCV_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID
FROM @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null
),
Mi_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.REM_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.REM_JRSDCN_CD, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.MANTAS_POST_DT, tr.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE, tr.DATA_DUMP_DT, DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Trxn_Am, tr.REM_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB, tr.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, (CASE WHEN tr.PASS_THRU_FL='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AMT, (CASE WHEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) - TRUNC(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM), -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) WHEN tr.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(tr.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) ELSE 0 END) LRF_AMT, case when tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt, tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, tr.REM_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.ISSUE_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.DEP_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.MI_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null
),
All_Trxn_Vw as ( -- WIRE ORIG SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, w.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.Trxn_Am as Trxn_Am_Dbt, 1 as Trxn_Ct_Dbt, 0 as Trxn_Am_Cdt, 0 as Trxn_Ct_Cdt, w.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN w.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN w.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, w.LRF_AMT, w.Trusted_Trans_Amt, w.FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Orig, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Send
WHERE (w.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.ORIG_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.ORIG_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID= Orig.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and w.SEND_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Send.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Orig.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Send.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL
-- WIRE BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, 0 as Trxn_Am_Dbt, 0 as Trxn_Ct_Dbt, w.Trxn_Am as Trxn_Am_Cdt, 1 as Trxn_Ct_Cdt, w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN w.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, w.LRF_AMT, w.Trusted_Trans_Amt, w.FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Bene, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Rcv
WHERE (w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Bene.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and w.RCV_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Rcv.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Bene.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Rcv.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL -- MI REM SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, m.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, m.Trxn_Am as Trxn_Am_Dbt, 1 as Trxn_Ct_Dbt, 0 as Trxn_Am_Cdt, 0 as Trxn_Ct_Cdt, m.REM_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, m.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN m.REM_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN m.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, m.LRF_AMT, m.Trusted_Trans_Amt, m.FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Rem, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Issue
WHERE (m.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.REM_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.REM_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.REM_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Rem.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and m.ISSUE_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Issue.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Rem.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Issue.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and m.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and m.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE >= (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) and m.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL -- MI BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM, m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.DATA_DUMP_DT as Dump_Dt, e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, 0 as Trxn_Am_Dbt, 0 as Trxn_Ct_Dbt, m.Trxn_Am as Trxn_Am_Cdt, 1 as Trxn_Ct_Cdt, m.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, m.PASS_THRU_AMT, CASE WHEN m.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN m.Trxn_Am ELSE 0 END as HR_AMT, m.LRF_AMT, m.Trusted_Trans_Amt, m.FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Bene, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Dep
WHERE (m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Bene.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and m.DEP_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Dep.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Bene.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Dep.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and m.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and m.MANTAS_POST_DT >= (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) and m.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
),
All_Trxn_Fin as( SELECT t.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, t.Dump_Dt, t.Efctv_Risk_Lvl, t.Trxn_Am_Dbt, t.Trxn_Ct_Dbt, t.Trxn_Am_Cdt, t.Trxn_Ct_Cdt, t.Actvty_Risk_Lvl, t.Hr_Amt, t.Lrf_Amt, t.Pass_Thru_Amt, t.Trusted_Trans_Amt, t.FUNC_CRNCY_CD, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, rownum) else null end as Other_Id, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end as Id_Driven, case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Trxn_Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id is null then 1 else 0 end as Nm_Driven FROM All_Trxn_Vw t ),
REPEATING_NOTREPEATING AS ( SELECT EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, CASE WHEN ( SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(MI_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(MI_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_IN_CT,0)+ COALESCE(CASH_TRXN_OUT_CT,0) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Ct AND SUM ( (CASE WHEN @Incl_Wire_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',WIRE_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Mi_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_IN_AM)+ DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',MI_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,MI_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END ) + (CASE WHEN @Incl_Cash_Trns_Fl ='Y' THEN DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_IN_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_IN_AM) + DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',CASH_TRXN_OUT_FUNC_AM,CASH_TRXN_OUT_AM) ELSE 0 END) ) >= @Min_EN_Trns_Amt ) THEN 'R' ELSE 'N' END AS EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL FROM @MINER@.EXTRL_NTITY_SMRY_MNTH ensm WHERE ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select Max_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) and ensm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select Min_Smry_Dt from clndr_vw) GROUP BY EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID )
--MAIN QUERY-- SELECT g.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id , g.Efctv_Risk_Lvl , g.Actvty_Risk_Lvl , g.Hr_Am , g.Pass_Thru_Am , g.Lrf_Am , g.Trxn_Am_Dbt , g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt , g.Trxn_Am_Cdt , g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt , g.Tot_Trans_Amt , g.Tot_Trans_Ct , g.Trusted_Trans_Amt , g.FUNC_CRNCY_CD , g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL , g.Overall_Risk , case when (g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end and g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end and g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end and g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) then 'BOTH' when (g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) then 'CREDIT' else 'DEBIT' end as Actvty_Type
FROM (SELECT tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id , max(tr.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) as Efctv_Risk_Lvl , max(tr.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl , sum(tr.Hr_Amt) as Hr_Am , sum(tr.Pass_Thru_Amt) as Pass_Thru_Am , sum(tr.Lrf_Amt) as Lrf_Am , sum(tr.Trxn_Am_Dbt) as Trxn_Am_Dbt , sum(tr.Trxn_Ct_Dbt) as Trxn_Ct_Dbt , sum(tr.Trxn_Am_Cdt) as Trxn_Am_Cdt , sum(tr.Trxn_Ct_Cdt) as Trxn_Ct_Cdt , sum(tr.Trxn_Am_Dbt)+sum(tr.Trxn_Am_Cdt) as Tot_Trans_Amt , sum(tr.Trxn_Ct_Dbt)+sum(tr.Trxn_Ct_Cdt) as Tot_Trans_Ct , sum(tr.Trusted_Trans_Amt) as Trusted_Trans_Amt , max(tr.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD , coalesce (r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL, 'N') as EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL , CASE WHEN (max(tr.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND max(tr.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl) THEN 'HR' WHEN (max(tr.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND max(tr.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl) THEN 'RR' ELSE 'MR' END AS Overall_Risk
FROM All_Trxn_Fin tr, REPEATING_NOTREPEATING r
WHERE tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id = r.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID (+)
GROUP BY tr.Extrl_Ntity_Seq_Id, r.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL
HAVING -- Frequency Period max(tr.Dump_Dt) > (select Freq_Dt from Clndr_vw) and max(tr.Dump_Dt) <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) -- ID_DRIVEN logic and (sum(tr.Id_Driven) = count(1) or count(distinct tr.Other_Id) > 1 or (sum(tr.Nm_Driven) = 1 and count(1) = 1)) ) g
WHERE (g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and ((g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) or (g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_HR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) ) ) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and ((g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) or (g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_MR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) ) ) OR (g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and ((g.Trxn_Am_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Cdt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Cdt_Ct end) or (g.Trxn_Am_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Amt end and g.Trxn_Ct_Dbt >= case when g.EXTRL_NTITY_TYPE_FL = 'R' then @RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct else @NR_RR_Min_Trxn_Dbt_Ct end) ) )

-- SUB RULE -- ML_OrgBenediffInstnCountry_EN_Wire with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt FROM dual ),
Wire_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, tr.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.ORIG_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, tr.ORIG_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.SEND_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.RCV_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID
FROM @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null
)
-- WIRE ORIG SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Orig, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Send
WHERE (w.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.ORIG_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.ORIG_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID= Orig.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and w.SEND_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Send.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Orig.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Send.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL
-- WIRE BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID
FROM Wire_Trxn_Vw w, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e
WHERE (w.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))

-- SUB RULE -- ML_OrgBenediffInstnCountry_EN_Mi with Clndr_vw as ( select (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Look_Back_Period - 1) as Min_Dt, (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt FROM dual ),
Mi_Trxn_Vw as (SELECT tr.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, tr.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, tr.REM_AUG_NM, tr.BENEF_AUG_NM, tr.REM_JRSDCN_CD, tr.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD, tr.MANTAS_POST_DT, tr.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE, tr.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL, tr.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL, tr.REM_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.ISSUE_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID, tr.DEP_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.MI_TRXN tr
WHERE (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' OR tr.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Ind_Trans_Amt and DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',tr.TRXN_FUNC_AM,tr.TRXN_BASE_AM) <= @Max_Ind_Trans_Amt and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (select Min_Dt from Clndr_vw) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from Clndr_vw) and (@Include_Related_Parties_Fl = 'Y' or (tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL = 'Y' or tr.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL IS NULL)) and (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl = 'Y' or NOT(tr.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and tr.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') and tr.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null )
-- MI REM SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Rem, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Issue
WHERE (m.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.REM_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.REM_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.REM_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Rem.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and m.ISSUE_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Issue.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Rem.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Issue.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and m.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and m.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE >= (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) and m.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))
UNION ALL -- MI BENE SELECT e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, m.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID
FROM Mi_Trxn_Vw m, @MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY e, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Bene, @MINER@.DERIVED_ADDRESS Dep
WHERE (m.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = e.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (m.BENEF_AUG_NM = e.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and m.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD = e.JRSDCN_CD)) and m.BENEF_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Bene.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and m.DEP_INSTN_ADDR_MSTR_SEQ_ID = Dep.DERVD_ADDR_SEQ_ID and Bene.ADDR_CNTRY_CD <> Dep.ADDR_CNTRY_CD and m.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and m.MANTAS_POST_DT >= (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) and m.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) -- Exclude Exempted External Entity and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and e.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or e.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value

Parameter that controls the inclusion or exclusion of transactions which have been designated as trusted transactions. Trusted transactions are those transactions considered trusted based upon the presence of one or more trusted pairs (parties identified as enjoying a trusted relationship) on the transaction.
